svg.title: readme.md - a markdown file that types itself
svg.desc: A terminal where a zsh prompt runs fastfetch with a block-letter Nyanpasu / Louis banner, a language bar and a pink contribution heatmap. After two cat commands are typed in parallel, a second two-column section shows a JSON personal-attributes file on the left and an MBTI result with four proportion bars plus an enneagram 1w2 nine-segment bar on the right, closing with a quote from Liu Cixin, then a fresh shell prompt with a blinking cursor. Everything is animated by CSS keyframes; the palette follows prefers-color-scheme.
